svg.aria-label: Google Drive high-level design. The user's app sends file blocks through block servers, which chunk, compress and encrypt them into cloud storage such as S3, with inactive files moved to cold storage. Metadata requests go through a load balancer to API servers, backed by a metadata cache and a metadata database. When a file changes, the notification service tells clients over long polling to pull the change, and an offline backup queue holds changes for clients that are offline.
svg.title: Google Drive architecture
